summary_out.hypothesis: Top-of-book size-asymmetry — a book-DEPTH axis structurally distinct from spread's quote-DISTANCE, chop's price-PATH, and flow's signed-trade pressure — adds residual EV-positive signal when stacked on top of the gen-2 three-gate stack. Two free variables differ from island-0 g1l2's null result: (1) composition partner (base-flow + spread + chop vs position-cap + spread), (2) threshold (size_asym_ratio=1.5, ~q<0.40/q>0.60 vs g1l2's q<0.30/q>0.70). The hypothesis ANY ONE of these may unlock the axis; the result confirms the stack but does not discriminate between (1) and (2). The gen-1 migration's flat 'queue imbalance is null' verdict is falsified as stated; the correct generalization is conditional on composition+threshold.
summary_out.next: Two structurally distinct directions, both informed by the four-axis stack now in place: (a) FIFTH-AXIS exploration — the most structurally distant remaining candidates from the gen-2 migration's named list are recent-trade-side flow (orthogonal to current aggressor-flow because it conditions on TRADE-side not net-volume sign) and price-velocity (recent mid-velocity, distinct from chop's path/range mechanic and from flow's pressure). Both worth trying; recent-trade-side flow is the more conservative first test because it stays in the trade-pressure family the base already gates on. (b) RETUNE existing operating points NOW that the stack has 4 gates — the surviving population is materially different from g2l2's, so the spread_quantile=0.75, chop_neutral=1.5, flow_threshold=2.0, and size_asym_ratio=1.5 operating points may all be off-optimum for the 4-gate surviving distribution. Recommendation for g4l1: (a) — add a fifth axis (recent-trade-side flow at a tight asymmetry threshold) before retuning, because the retune surface is now 4-dimensional and a single-axis sweep would be uninformative without first establishing the next axis. Falsification for g4l1: trade_count drop >10% OR pnl regression > 2% means the four-axis stack is the empirical ceiling and g4l2 should pivot to multi-axis retuning. Cross-island signal for gen-3 migration: queue-imbalance is NOT a base-agnostic null — it's a conditional finding governed by composition and threshold.
